section.content: 本发明公开了一种锂离子电池，所述锂离子电池正极片的活性物质为LiCoO2，负极片活性物质为石墨；导电剂为导电碳黑，导电剂在电解液中的质量含量为7％～9％；所述正极片的厚度为110μm～130μm，所述负极片的厚度为110μm～130μm。本发明所提供的锂离子电池工作温度范围可以适用深空领域。

The invention discloses a lithium ion battery, wherein the active material of a positive plate of the lithium ion battery is LiCoO2The active substance of the negative plate is graphite; the conductive agent is conductive carbon black, and the conductive agent isThe mass content of the electrolyte is 7-9%; the thickness of the positive plate is 110-130 μm, and the thickness of the negative plate is 110-130 μm. The working temperature range of the lithium ion battery provided by the invention can be suitable for the deep space field.

Lithium ion batteryTechnical Field

The invention belongs to the technical field of lithium ion batteries for space, and particularly relates to a fully-sealed lithium ion battery which is suitable for a wide temperature range and used for deep space exploration.

Background

At present, the service temperature of a fully-sealed lithium ion battery for a space is generally 0-30 ℃, and the wider requirement of a deep space exploration aircraft on the adaptive temperature range of the lithium ion battery is difficult to meet.

Disclosure of Invention

As known in the background art, the existing lithium ion battery is not suitable for a deep space exploration aircraft; in order to solve the problems, the invention provides a lithium ion battery with a wide working temperature range.

In the lithium ion battery provided by the invention, the active substance of the positive plate is LiCoO2The active substance of the negative plate is graphite; the conductive agent is conductive carbon black, and the mass content of the conductive agent in the electrolyte is 7-9%.

Further, the thickness of the positive electrode sheet is 110 to 130 μm, and the thickness of the negative electrode sheet is 110 to 130 μm.

Furthermore, the positive plate, the negative plate and the polyethylene polypropylene composite diaphragm clamped between the positive plate and the negative plate form a plate group, and the plate group is of a laminated structure.

Further, still include: welding an aluminum alloy battery shell and an aluminum alloy battery bottom into a whole; the positive pole column, the negative pole column and the aluminum alloy battery cover are combined into a whole; and the anode tab is welded at one end of the anode column close to the bottom of the aluminum alloy battery, and the cathode tab is welded at one end of the cathode column close to the bottom of the aluminum alloy battery.

Further, the electrolyte consists of a multi-element organic solvent and electrolyte salt; the organic solvent comprises a low-melting-point organic solvent and a fluorine-containing organic solvent.

The technical effects of the invention comprise: because the parameters of the positive and negative pole pieces are optimized, the content of the conductive agent is improved, the thickness of the pole pieces is reduced, the formula of the electrolyte is adjusted, and the working capacity of the lithium ion battery in a low-temperature environment and the adaptability of the lithium ion battery in a high-temperature environment are improved.

Drawings

Fig. 1 is a schematic structural diagram of a fully-sealed rectangular lithium ion battery applied in a wide temperature range according to the present invention.

Detailed Description

The background art can know that the existing lithium ion battery is influenced by the working temperature and is not suitable for the deep space field, and the inventor researches the problem and considers that the main reason of the narrow working temperature range of the existing lithium ion battery is (the proposal is briefly explained); through further research, in the embodiment of the invention, the working temperature range of the lithium ion battery is widened by optimizing the parameters of the positive plate and the negative plate and the formula of the electrolyte.

In the examples of the present invention, the active material of the positive electrode sheet was LiCoO2The active substance of the negative plate is graphite; the conductive agent is conductive carbon black, and the mass content of the conductive agent in the electrolyte is 7-9%; the battery weight ratio energy can be reduced when the content of the conductive agent is too high, the battery impedance can be increased when the content of the conductive agent is too low, and through a large number of theoretical and experimental researches, when the conductive agent selects conductive carbon black and the mass content of the conductive agent in the electrolyte is 7-9%, the performance of the lithium ion battery can meet the requirements of the deep space field.

The thickness of the positive plate is 110-130 μm, and the thickness of the negative plate is 110-130 μm; the thickness design can reduce the migration distance of lithium ions without influencing monomer assembly. The positive plate and the negative plate which meet the parameter setting can reduce the mobility of lithium ions without influencing the monomer assembly.

The electrolyte consists of a multi-element organic solvent and electrolyte salt; the organic solvent comprises a low-melting-point organic solvent and a fluorine-containing organic solvent, the low-melting-point organic solvent can reduce the migration resistance of lithium ions in the electrolyte, and diethyl carbonate is selected in one embodiment; the fluorine-containing organic solvent can improve the stability of the electrolyte. The working temperature range of the lithium ion battery can be widened by adopting the measures and can reach-20 ℃ to 55 ℃.

Referring to fig. 1, a lithium ion battery provided in an embodiment of the present invention includes: the aluminum alloy battery comprises an aluminum alloy battery cover 1, an aluminum alloy battery case 2, an aluminum alloy battery bottom 3, a positive pole column 4, a negative pole column 5, a pole piece group 6, a positive pole lug 7 and a negative pole lug 8; in order to realize the sealing of the lithium ion battery, the aluminum alloy battery shell 2 and the aluminum alloy battery bottom 3 are welded into a whole, and the welding can adopt argon arc welding; the positive pole post 4, the negative pole post 5 and the aluminum alloy battery cover 1 are combined into a whole; the aluminum alloy battery cover 1 covers the aluminum alloy battery shell 2 to form a sealed rectangular shell; the positive plate, the negative plate and the polyethylene polypropylene composite diaphragm clamped between the positive plate and the negative plate form a pole piece group 6, and the pole piece group 6 is of a laminated structure and is arranged in the rectangular shell;

the positive pole tab 7 and the negative pole tab 8 are respectively led out from one end of the pole piece group close to the aluminum alloy battery cover and are welded with the positive pole column 4 and the negative pole column 5 into a whole through ultrasonic waves; a positive electrode tab 7 and a negative electrode tab 8 are placed in the rectangular shell; electrolyte is injected through a small hole in the center of the aluminum alloy battery cover 1, and the small hole is used as an injection hole and sealed by argon arc welding after injection.

Although the present invention has been described with reference to the preferred embodiments, it is not intended to limit the present invention, and those skilled in the art can make variations and modifications of the present invention without departing from the spirit and scope of the present invention by using the methods and technical contents disclosed above.
